# OrbNote

OrbNote 3.0 is a conversational notebook for Apple devices. It helps people capture text, photos, voice, files, and checklists as messages, keep related context inside Threads, and organize content later when structure becomes useful.

## Primary pages

- English home: https://www.orbnote.app/en/
- 中文首页: https://www.orbnote.app/zh/
- English articles: https://www.orbnote.app/articles/
- 中文文章: https://www.orbnote.app/zh/articles/
- English Wiki: https://www.orbnote.app/en/wiki/
- 中文 Wiki: https://www.orbnote.app/zh/wiki/

## Key guides

- Conversational note-taking: https://www.orbnote.app/articles/conversational-note-taking/
- 对话式笔记: https://www.orbnote.app/zh/articles/conversational-note-taking/
- Quick Jot: https://www.orbnote.app/en/wiki/quick-jot/
- 随手记: https://www.orbnote.app/zh/wiki/quick-jot/
- AI Organization: https://www.orbnote.app/en/wiki/ai-organization/
- AI 智能整理: https://www.orbnote.app/zh/wiki/ai-organization/

## Product terminology

- Thread is translated as “会话” in Simplified Chinese.
- AI Organization is translated as “AI 智能整理” in Simplified Chinese.
- Quick Jot is introduced as “随手记 Quick Jot” and may be shortened to “随手记”.

All public pages are available as static HTML and may be crawled by search engines and AI search services.
